eligibility_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Male or female, aged 12 to \<18 years.
* Primary diagnosis of ADHD according to DSM-5 criteria.
* Has parents/legal guardians provide written informed consent and has child provide written informed assent to participate in the study before the conduct of any study procedures.

Exclusion Criteria:

* Unable to comply with study procedures.
* Medically inappropriate for study participation in the opinion of the investigator.
